table_title: CONTENTS, IN ACRE-FEET, AT 2400, WATER YEAR OCTOBER 1970 TO SEPTEMBER 1971
site_name: PINE FLAT LAKE NEAR PIEDRA, CALIF. (Formerly published as Pine Flat Reservoir near Piedra)
location_text: Lat 36°49'58", long 119°19'29", in NE1/4 sec.2, T.13 S., R.24 E., Fresno County, near center of Pine Flat Dam on Kings River, 1.9 miles upstream from Mill Creek, 3.5 miles northeast of Piedra, and 16 miles northeast of Sanger.
quantities_units: contents (acre-feet); elevation at end of month (feet); change in contents (acre-feet); evaporation (acre-feet)
notes: Table 2 is the daily contents grid; table 1 on the page is the capacity table (elevation vs contents, no time series). Daily values are contents; elevation, change in contents and evaporation appear only as monthly summary rows (a), (b), (c) at the foot. Period of record (October 1951 to current year) not used for years.
